# rustinion_remote_access_dlp (Resource)

Manages the data-loss policy (what each remote-access channel may carry: clipboard formats and sizes, file types and sizes, drives, printing, USB classes, audio, recording, session limits) at one level: the organization, a group or a device. A policy at a level can only narrow what the levels above allow; the effective policy is the intersection of all levels, and a channel that is switched off carries nothing. Give a `preset` (support, locked_down, full, kiosk) or a `policy_json`; destroying the resource clears the level.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) `tenant` (your organization), `group` or `device`.

### Optional

- `policy_json` (String) The policy as JSON; keys you leave out take the locked-down defaults. Use `jsonencode`.
- `preset` (String) `support`, `locked_down`, `full` or `kiosk`. Give this or `policy_json`.
- `scope_id` (String) The group or device id (omit for `tenant`).

### Read-Only

- `effective_json` (String) The effective policy and channel switches for this scope (all levels combined), as JSON.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
